title: Behaviour expectations
intro: There are only three things I want from you.

pillars.title: Be safe
pillars.concrete: Safe means no pushing, grabbing, dangerous tackles or kicking balls at people.

pillars.title: Work as a team
pillars.concrete: Teamwork means encouraging people and helping your teammates, not blaming them.

pillars.title: Try your hardest
pillars.concrete: Trying your hardest doesn't mean being the best player. It means having a go.

coachPromise: And I'll promise you something as well. I'll try my hardest to make it fun.
consequences: If you forget one of those, I'll remind you.
If it keeps happening, you'll come out for a quick reset with me.
If something is unsafe or really unkind, I might stop you straight away.
Then once you're ready, you come straight back in.
